issues.problem: Compound particle written in kana inside braces ({をちゅうしんに}, {をちゅうしんとした}, {をちゅうしんで}, {をちゅうしんの}); AUTHORING requires kanji with furigana for compound particles normally written in kanji.
issues.action: Rewrote all 10 slots as {を中心[ちゅうしん]…}.

issues.problem: Example translates 田中さんを中心としたチーム as 'A team led by Tanaka'; を中心とした means centred on, not led by.
issues.action: Changed the English to 'A team built around Tanaka'.

issues.problem: The mistake note for 雨が降っていたとしても、出かけた。 says 'You know it was raining', but the sentence gives no such context; the real signal is that bare 出かけた reports an actual event.
issues.action: Reworded the note to point to 出かけた as the reason it must be 'even though' (けど / のに).
